judgment: It is good for a woman to hold firm.
image: Wind comes out of fire: Household.
So the noble one lets words have substance
lines: at the cooking in the middle rooms.
The king comes to have a household.
There is trust, and dignity with it.

notes.name_en: 家人 the people of the house; 'Household', not Wilhelm's 'The Family (The Clan)'.
notes.L5: 假 reads gé 'comes to', as in 王假有廟 (glossary).
